---
name: Change or question
about: Track an idea, question, blocker or change; optional for small changes
---

## Outcome

What should work or be clearer when this task is done?

## Context

- Person asking / agent if used (optional):
- Component and expected files/contracts:
- Related PRs/handoffs; people to coordinate with:

## How to verify

Local checks, synthetic fixtures or an explicitly scoped read-only status check. State missing access/input evidence. Don't post credentials or private AWS records.

## AWS boundary

Default: local only. If AWS is needed, specify the requested activity and owner coordination; agree exact approval/cost privately before processing/deployment. A task issue is not spending approval or a cloud lock.

## Finish

Push the scoped changes and handoff, open a PR, report the commit/checks/next step and merge after checks (self-merge is allowed). Other teammates read open PRs before starting overlapping work.
